questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Understanding Utility-Class Naming?
options: Tailwind scans complete candidate tokens in source files and generates matching CSS
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: Tailwind scans complete candidate tokens in source files and generates matching CSS
questions.explanation: Understanding Utility-Class Naming is best understood through the syllabus topics: Utility names and their CSS equivalents, Property-oriented utility naming, Value scales. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with understanding utility-class naming?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
use complete class names or a static map, then inspect the generated output
questions.answer_key: use complete class names or a static map, then inspect the generated output
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Utility names and their CSS equivalents, Property-oriented utility naming, Value scales, Utility combinations.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying understanding utility-class naming?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
string interpolation can hide complete class names from source detection
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: string interpolation can hide complete class names from source detection
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
